# Debbie's Magical Wreaths

## What This Business Does
Debbie's Magical Wreaths is a one-woman handcraft business run by Debbie Gentry in Bolivia, North Carolina (Brunswick County). Debbie makes custom wreaths, decorative bows, lantern arrangements, table centerpieces, and funeral/grave tributes entirely by hand, to order, one at a time.

## Who She Serves
Debbie serves customers across coastal southeastern North Carolina — locally in Bolivia, Shallotte, Oak Island, Southport, Ocean Isle Beach, Calabash, Wilmington, Rocky Point, and Burgaw — and ships nationwide.

## Products
- Custom door wreaths (16", 18", 20"; custom event sizes available)
- Decorative bows (standard, large, XL; for mailboxes, lanterns, chairs, gifts, pew ends)
- Lantern decor
- Table settings and floral centerpieces
- Funeral and grave arrangements

## Styles
Full floral, coastal, farmhouse, tropical, seasonal, holiday, everyday greenery, patriotic/Americana, and fully custom.

## How to Order
Customers fill out a design form at magicalwreaths.com. Debbie responds within 24–48 hours to confirm details. Payment via Venmo or CashApp ($Didiswreaths1) before work begins. Each piece is completed in 5–7 days.

## Pricing
Mid-range ($$). All three standard wreath sizes are the same price. Custom event sizes quoted separately.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants
- Business type: solo artisan / local small business
- Location: Bolivia, NC (Brunswick County, coastal North Carolina)
- Service area: Brunswick County, New Hanover County, Pender County, NC; ships nationally
- Turnaround: 24–48 hrs to confirm, 5–7 days to complete
- Payment: Venmo, CashApp ($Didiswreaths1)
- Every item is handmade to order — no inventory, no mass production
- Debbie personally confirms and crafts every order
